outcome: diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound in detecting abnormally invasive placenta (AIP)
cohort: 188 women with placenta previa and at least one previous Cesarean section or uterine surgery
finding: Ultrasound performed between 11 and 14 weeks' gestation has good diagnostic accuracy for detecting all types of abnormally invasive placenta (AIP) in women with placenta previa and prior uterine scar.
